descriptionEn: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
summaryPt: Orbe de gelo que pulsa aplicando Exposure (reduz resistências). No fim explode em dano de frio e deixa uma Cold Infusion.
